# Field Notes on E-Ink Reading

E-ink screens reflect light. They do not glow. This makes them **easy on the eyes** for long reading.

## Why simple layouts work

- One column of text
- No floats or sidebars
- Images no wider than the screen

Read the [CrossPoint firmware notes](https://example.org/crosspoint) for details.

```
width  = 480
height = 800
```

> Less is more on a small screen.
